NOTIFICATION
TRAINED GRADUATE TEACHER ON-2026 (SECONDARY LEVEL)
In partial modification of the earlier Notification vide No. PSC-R(A)11912021 dated 24th
August, 2026, and in pursuance of the meeting convened with the Department of Education and
subsequent Minutes of the Meeting of even no. dated 9th Septemb er 2026, the below mentioned
candidate with the educational qualification of B. Com in Information System does not fulfil the
prescribed educational qualification for TGT (Economics), as Economics was not studied in all
semesters of the graduation programme, as required under the relevant Recruitment Rules and
Advertisement No. 0212026 dated 23,03.2026 issued for Trained Graduate Teacher Examination-
2026 (Secondary Level).
Accordingly, the earlier acceptance of the candidature is hereby withdrawn, and the
candidate is declared INELIGIBLE for the post of TGT (Economics) and her candidature for
Trained Graduate Teacher Examiantion-2026 (Secondary Level) is REJBCTED.
